review.summary: Meera asked whether she was speaking to Ujjwal Goel, and the borrower said yes and gave his name as Ujjwal. Meera did not accept this and asked for the full name twice with the same 'could not hear' line. The call stopped there, with no talk about the EMI, no payment discussion and no close.
review.nextStep: Call the borrower back and move on from identity once he confirms; review why Meera looped on the name question.
